name: [[690,46,9]] periodic bivariate-bicycle on Z_23 x Z_15

provenance.construction: Periodic bivariate-bicycle code on the group algebra Z_23 x Z_15 (n = 2*l*m = 690). Convention: x = S_23 tensor I_15, y = I_23 tensor S_15 (cyclic shifts), qubit index = i*m + j; A = 1 + x^0y^11 + x^7y^2 + x^7y^8, B = 1 + x^0y^1; H_X = [A|B], H_Z = [B^T|A^T].
